# Thermodynamics problem sheet

Q1. An ideal gas is compressed isothermally from $V_1$ to $V_2$.

(a) Find the work done on the gas.

(b) Find the heat rejected.

Solution: $W = nRT\ln(V_1/V_2)$.

Solution: $Q = W$, since the internal energy does not change.

Q2. Find the efficiency of a Carnot engine between 300 K and 600 K.

Solution: $\eta = 1 - T_c/T_h = 0.5$.
